Here is the plan to tidy the `notes` folder without changing any file contents:

### 1. How Dates Are Determined
Rather than relying solely on the existing filenames, I read the `# Committee meeting, <Date>` heading inside each file to confirm the actual date the meeting took place. 

Notably, [minutes 25 aug.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/minutes%2025%20aug.md#L1-L3) has `25 aug` in its filename, but its heading and text state:
> `# Committee meeting, 26 August 2026`
> `Moved from Monday 25 August because of the storm.`

So it will be named for **2026-08-26** (the actual date of the meeting), not `2026-08-25`. All other filenames match the meeting dates inside their headings.

### 2. Planned File Renames (via `mv`)
| Current Filename | Heading Date | New Filename |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [aug11.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/aug11.md) | 11 August 2026 | `notes/2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md` |
| [minutes 25 aug.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/minutes%2025%20aug.md) | 26 August 2026 | `notes/2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md` |
| [Meeting sept 8.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/Meeting%20sept%208.md) | 8 September 2026 | `notes/2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md` |
| [notes_2026-09-22.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/notes_2026-09-22.md) | 22 September 2026 | `notes/2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md` |
| [oct6 meeting notes.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/oct6%20meeting%20notes.md) | 6 October 2026 | `notes/2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md` |
| [2026.10.20 minutes.md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/2026.10.20%20minutes.md) | 20 October 2026 | `notes/2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md` |
| [Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t3-practice-r2/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md) | 3 November 2026 | `notes/2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md` |

### 3. Creating `notes/index.md`
I will create `notes/index.md` listing the 7 meetings in chronological order, linking to each renamed file with a one-line summary of what was decided/assigned at that meeting:
- **`2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md`**: Accepted Odile's offer to repaint the noticeboard, decided Paolo will switch shed lights to the night rate, and tasked Nell with asking the city about adding a second tap.
- **`2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md`**: Confirmed the switch to the night electricity rate and that Nell will follow up with the city on the second tap before the next meeting.
- **`2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md`**: Agreed to replace the shed roof before winter (Tessa to get three quotes) and tasked Ibrahim with emailing autumn fee reminders.
- **`2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md`**: Selected the $1,480 quote to replace the shed roof, tasked Nell with ordering 4 m³ of compost, and transferred the city second-tap inquiry to Dov Marchetti.
- **`2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md`**: Assigned Wren to replace the broken gate latch and Tessa to draft the winter closing checklist (including water shut-off).
- **`2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md`**: Held payment on the $1,560 roof invoice until Paolo queries the $80 overage, and scheduled the autumn work day for 14 November with a tool sharpener and soup.
- **`2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md`**: Maintained the hold on the roof invoice pending explanation, set the 10 November deadline for checklist comments, and assigned work-day tasks (Ibrahim to send notice, Wren to shut off water).

### 4. Verification That No Text Was Lost
1. **Before renaming:** Compute SHA-256 checksums (`shasum -a 256`) and exact byte counts of all 7 original files.
2. **Rename operation:** Use `mv` so files are moved in place rather than rewritten.
3. **After renaming:** Re-run `shasum -a 256` on the renamed files and compare every hash and byte count against the pre-move values to verify 100% byte-for-byte identity, and confirm with `ls -la notes` that all 7 renamed notes plus `index.md` are present.
